## Summary

Describe the change and the user-facing effect.

## Checks

- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks locally.
- [ ] I updated documentation, disclosures, or help content where needed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, production data, database exports, or wallet seed material.

## Privacy, security, and governance impact

Describe any impact on identity separation, data exposure, moderation,
permanence, wallets, the ledger, or project governance. Write "None known" if
there is no expected impact.

## Notes for reviewers

Link the relevant issue or design discussion. Security vulnerabilities must be
reported privately under [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not described here.
